[EN] We're trying to make sure that civilian life here continues as uninterrupted as possible. The citizens need to feel safe and secure.

As you can see, we're not having an easy go of it.
[ES] Intentamos asegurarnos de que la vida civil aquí continúe lo más ininterrumpida posible. Los ciudadanos necesitan sentirse seguros y protegidos.

Como puedes ver, no la estamos pasando nada fácil.
